comment: Source of truth for all tools used in this project. ensure-tools.sh reads this. Add a tool here and it will be auto-restored on every codespace attach.

llama-server.purpose: Crystal baking — evaluates persona prompt into KV slot

android-sdk.purpose: Build MollyBrowser APK, adb push to tablet

adb.purpose: Push APK and crystal files to Revvl Tab 2

bun.purpose: Fast JS runtime used in build scripts

ollama.note: Managed by devcontainer, should not disappear. If missing: curl -fsSL https://ollama.ai/install.sh | sh
ollama.purpose: Molly brain fallback when Gemini is down

tsx.note: Available as npx tsx or node_modules/.bin/tsx — no global install needed
